title: CLAUS watch, week 3
disclosure: Since 7 Nov 2026 Josh (@holdembuilds), who runs Blockpin, holds an advisor role with Claus and receives a 0.1% ETH share of Robinhood CLAUS pool volume, paid by the Robinhood fee hook to 0x1C31B012a8565567A72F7c661D7f0d9f92182853. This record covers the Ethereum contracts only and is published whichever way it reads.

moduleChanges.sentBy: founder 0xbb14…f1c5 through contract 0xdb9b1e94b5b69df7e401ddbede43491141047db3, two blocks after taking token ownership back
moduleChanges.notice: No 1 h public notice found before this switch; Claus later said the NFT share was paused without a vote or notice. Blockpin alert posted 6 Nov 16:22 UTC (x.com/holdembuilds/status/2118740781657669994).

execution.note: Under the treasury-only module 0x19de (from 6 Nov 00:27 UTC) trades are recorded and fees settle by claim to a fixed recipient, so no execute calls are expected; its 0 executions are by design, not a gap.

daysFourToSevenNeverExecuted.note: Receipts recorded under 0x0f4a from 5 Nov 01:59 UTC until the 6 Nov switch with no TradeExecuted by the end block. Same pattern as the replaced-module receipts raised in W44.

migrationGate1.note: Single burn by the founder: the 30.94M CLAUS from LP withdrawal 1, migrated through gate 1.

keeperBuybackBurns.note: One buyback run in the window (8 Nov). Buybacks effectively stopped after the treasury-only switch.

hookBurns10Nov.note: 43.33M CLAUS held by the hook 0x37bf…bfff was burned at 03:31 UTC 10 Nov in 4 transactions sent by outside wallets (0x6ad3fb58… via 0xf675fcd0…, and 0x9235910f… via 0x00000f91…), each looping 35-185 small swaps through the hooked pool; on every swap the pool sent CLAUS to the hook and the hook burned it. Hook CLAUS balance afterwards: 0. Not triggered by Claus or the keeper. Why the hook held this CLAUS and whether the callers profited is not yet traced; question sent to Claus.

whereTheOldClausWent.outcome: withdrawn 3 min after gate 2 closed, then sold on Ethereum at 21:23 UTC 6 Nov through 0x74de5d4f…
whereTheOldClausWent.note: Claus says (TG 9 Nov) the same 14.01M was credited on Robinhood by the snapshot (11.0M added to the Robinhood pool, 3.0M kept in 0xbb14); he called the sale a fair criticism.

founderLiquidityAndOldClaus.note: All CLAUS transfers out of 0xbb14 in the window are the four above. Old Ethereum CLAUS cannot be bridged; only the ETH crossed to Robinhood.

notCovered: Robinhood Chain contracts (the agreed Robinhood watch is not posted as a task yet); Buy & Hodl winner payouts and draw rounds (not traced this week).
method: eth_call (owner, pendingOwner, operator, activeModule) at the end block via publicnode; event logs of the token (ownership, burns to 0x0), controller and TradeExtensionHost (TradeRecorded, TradeExecuted, ModuleChanged) from Blockscout and rpc.mevblocker.io; transaction receipts for every listed tx.
